integrity: The proof is exact. The finite random stress test reported in verification was used only as a consistency check and is not evidence for the infinite-dimensional theorem.
scientific_limitations: The sharpness statement is for universal guarantees determined only by the displayed perturbation parameters; particular families may remain \(K\)-fusion frames beyond the threshold.
The mathematical source inspected in full is arXiv:1801.02785v2; the later journal publication was identified bibliographically but not used to strengthen the theorem-level claim.
title: Sharp smallness threshold for a \(K\)-fusion perturbation theorem
